patch_summary: Replaced context-free taint booleans with per-sink-class taint sets in TaintAnalyzer: sink arguments are now scanned for tainted names anywhere inside the expression tree (BinOp, f-strings, %-formatting, str.format, join, keyword/list args) plus nested source calls; sanitizers are sink-specific via exact matching (shlex.quote for shell, html.escape/markupsafe.escape for HTML, secure_filename for path, int/float/bool universal, nothing for SQL/generic); unknown calls propagate taint (removed substring matching that treated print_and_return as sanitized). Added render_template_string/mark_safe HTML sinks. Two commits: 82c90f5 test, d490e40 fix.
root_cause: Sink check only matched bare variable names against the taint map so taint inside expressions was lost; one global SANITIZERS set with substring matching made html.escape sanitize shell sinks and misclassified print_and_return (contains 'int') as sanitized.
